payload.title: [Kanbus-web] kanb.us has no <title>, no meta description/og tags, and robots.txt and sitemap.xml return 404
payload.description:
**Problem**
The live site https://kanb.us/ (Gatsby, apps/kanb.us; Kanbus-web cutover is pending, see the cutover issue c3e738) ships without basic SEO and sharing metadata.

**Evidence**
- `curl -s https://kanb.us/ | grep -i '<title'` returns nothing; no meta description or og: tags.
- `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://kanb.us/robots.txt` returns 404.
- `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://kanb.us/sitemap.xml` returns 404.

**Fix**
Add a title, meta description and og:/twitter: tags to the site, and generate robots.txt and sitemap.xml. If the Kanbus-web (Markus/Papyrus) site replaces it at cutover, make sure the new build ships the same metadata and fix it there instead.

**How to verify**
`curl -s https://kanb.us/ | grep -ci '<title'` is at least 1, `og:title` is present, and both `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://kanb.us/robots.txt` and `.../sitemap.xml` return 200.

Source: Anthus repo audit, 2026-10-20.
